migration.objective: Add an internal Postgres store for atomic multi-instance sliding-window rate limiting.
migration.target_environment: Supabase Postgres deployment profile; rehearse on disposable local Postgres first

authority.point_of_no_return_approver: not applicable; no point of no return

include: Create public.rate_limit_hits with caller-window and cleanup indexes
Enable RLS and revoke Data API roles
Deploy the B-3 FastAPI reader/writer only after schema expansion
exclude: Applying any SQL to live Supabase in this task
Changing Android or the HTTP error/header contract
maintenance_or_downtime_constraints: No planned downtime; the table is additive and initially empty

source.database_engine_and_version: Supabase Postgres live version unknown; disposable test version discovered at rehearsal
data_profile_evidence: No rate-limit table or historical rows exist
Live Supabase has not been inspected or mutated
Migrations 004 through 006 remain prepared and unapplied

application_revisions: B-3 commit to be pinned after integration
invariants: At most the configured allowance is accepted per hashed caller and bucket in any 60-second sliding window
No bearer token, debug user id, or IP address is stored in plaintext
No Data API client role can access rate_limit_hits

caches_events_and_replicas: No cache or event consumer; normal database replication applies
mixed_version_compatibility: Old FastAPI revisions ignore the additive table
B-3 FastAPI refuses startup until migration 007 exists
Apply schema first, then deploy code; rollback code before optional table removal
privacy_retention_security: caller_key is a truncated SHA-256 digest with a source-type prefix
Rows are ephemeral and expired rows are removed in bounded batches
RLS is enabled with no client policy and all Data API roles are revoked

operations.name: Preflight live schema and recovery evidence
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Confirm migrations 004, 005, and 006 are applied in order; confirm backup status and current Postgres version; review SQL and live schema drift.
operations.idempotency_and_restart: All checks are read-only and may be restarted
operations.verification: Expected columns and indexes from migrations 004-006 exist
monitoring: Record exact schema revision, Postgres version, and backup state
operations.pause_or_abort: Stop on schema drift, failed backup evidence, or missing authority

operations.name: Expand schema with rate-limit storage
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Apply supabase/007_add_shared_rate_limits.sql once through the approved SQL workflow.
operations.transaction_and_locking: One short DDL transaction on a new empty table; no existing data rewrite
operations.compatibility: Old application revisions ignore the new table
operations.idempotency_and_restart: CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and guarded indexes make a clean matching target re-runnable; stop on divergent pre-existing objects
operations.verification: Run the column, RLS, grants, and index queries embedded in migration 007
operations.pause_or_abort: Abort on any SQL error or unexpected existing object definition
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Transaction rollback before commit; after commit the unused additive table may remain

operations.name: Switch FastAPI to the shared store
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Deploy the pinned B-3 FastAPI revision and perform health plus rate-limit smoke checks.
preconditions: B-3 commit and configuration are pinned
operations.transaction_and_locking: Per request, transaction-level advisory lock scoped to hashed caller and bucket
operations.compatibility: Requires migration 007; startup fails with a named message when absent
operations.idempotency_and_restart: Application deployment is repeatable; limiter rows are ephemeral and need no backfill
operations.verification: Two instances jointly accept exactly the configured allowance and return canonical 429 headers thereafter
operations.pause_or_abort: Rollback application on startup failure, elevated 5xx, database pool exhaustion, or incorrect allowance
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Redeploy the pre-B-3 application; leave the additive table in place

operations.name: Observe shared limiter behavior
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Observe database latency, lock waits, pool saturation, 429 rate, and expired-row count through the agreed window.
operations.idempotency_and_restart: Observation queries may be repeated without mutation
operations.verification: No sustained lock waits or unbounded expired rows
operations.pause_or_abort: Rollback application if rate-limit database work materially degrades API availability
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Application rollback; evaluate Redis only with measured evidence

estimates_and_measurements: Derived: table is empty at creation, so DDL duration should be short; live duration remains unmeasured
One small database transaction is added per limited request
Cleanup deletes at most 1000 expired rows per request
rehearsal: Apply the disposable postgres_schema.sql on a local-only database
Run concurrent calls through two PostgresDatabase instances
Run the full credential-free suite even when local Postgres is unavailable
correctness_and_reconciliation: Exactly limit requests are allowed under concurrent two-instance load
Allowed remaining values count down to zero
Expired rows age out and different caller/bucket keys remain independent
Data API roles have zero privileges
backup: Confirm Supabase backup state before live execution even though the migration is additive
restore_or_forward_recovery: Rollback app first; retaining the unused table is safe
Drop the table only in a separately approved cleanup after all B-3 readers/writers are retired
monitoring_and_alerts: Postgres lock waits and connection-pool saturation
429 response rate by bucket without logging caller keys
Count and age of expired rate_limit_hits
pause_abort_thresholds: Any unexpected schema drift or privilege exposure
Any concurrent test accepting more than the configured limit
Any plaintext credential or caller identifier in persisted rows
Any sustained API availability regression attributable to the limiter
hold_points: Local/Postgres rehearsal evidence is attached before deployment
safety.observation_window: At least one normal demo/use session after deployment; exact production duration is not yet approved

decisions_needed: Approve when to apply migrations 004 through 007 to live Supabase
blockers: No live Supabase schema or runtime verification is authorized in this task
assumptions: Deployment uses the direct Postgres connection configured by CRETONA_DATABASE_URL
Expected course-project traffic is low enough for one rate-limit transaction per request
unknowns: Live Supabase Postgres version, row counts, backup state, and schema drift
Observed database latency under representative multi-instance traffic
limitations: Local SQLite proof is not live Supabase proof
Hashing identifiers is pseudonymization, not anonymization
Cleanup runs on incoming limited traffic rather than a separate scheduler
residual_risks: A database outage makes protected endpoints unavailable instead of failing open
Advisory-lock hash collisions may serialize unrelated callers
Bearer-token rotation creates a new caller key under the preserved pre-auth middleware contract
evidence_ledger_targets: Live migration verification remains separate and pending
